boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Storrs-campus places for studying, making, gathering, and taking in arts or performances, with access details checked against UConn sources.

cards.title: Homer Babbidge Library
cards.subtitle: 369 Fairfield Way
cards.notes: Start here when your group needs a campus hub: choose a quiet or collaborative area, then use the library’s listed services for research, printing, or support.
cards.short_summary: A central Storrs library building with study environments and academic-support services.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn describes Homer Babbidge Library as its Storrs intellectual, learning, cultural, and social hub, with quiet and collaborative spaces plus printing, tutoring, and technology services.
cards.source_title: Homer Babbidge Library Hours | UConn Library
cards.access_notes: After 8 p.m., entry—including 24-hour study spaces—requires a UConn ID. Check the library’s current hours page before going.

cards.title: Babbidge Booths
cards.subtitle: Homer Babbidge Library, Levels B–4
cards.notes: Use a booth for a focused one- or two-person work session; they are first come, first served, so have a nearby library table as a backup.
cards.short_summary: Small first-come study booths distributed across several library levels.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn Library lists Babbidge Booths on Levels B, Plaza, 1, 2, 3, and 4, with occupancy of one to two people and first-come, first-served use.
cards.access_notes: Located inside Homer Babbidge Library; library building access after 8 p.m. requires a UConn ID.

cards.title: Maker Studio
cards.subtitle: Homer Babbidge Library, Level B
cards.notes: Plan a hands-on break from screen work: complete the required equipment and safety orientation, then ask staff about tools for a research or creative project.
cards.short_summary: A library fabrication studio with 3-D printers, a laser engraver, and a vinyl cutter.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn Library says the Maker Studio is on Level B of Homer Babbidge Library and houses 3-D printers, a laser engraver, vinyl cutter, and more; users first complete equipment and safety orientation.
cards.source_title: Homer Babbidge Library Room Listing | UConn Library
cards.access_notes: Open to all according to UConn Library; equipment use requires a completed orientation.

cards.title: UConn Student Union
cards.subtitle: 2110 Hillside Road
cards.notes: Use the directory to choose a meetup point before you arrive, whether the plan is a public lounge, the game room, cultural center, or campus service.
cards.short_summary: A centrally located student-services building with lounges, meeting areas, dining, and campus organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn Student Union identifies public lounges, meetup spaces, a theatre, game room, dining and retail, cultural centers, student organizations, and offices within the building.
cards.source_title: Home | Student Union and Event Services | University of Connecticut
cards.access_notes: Consult the Student Union’s current building hours and directory before visiting; specific offices and services may keep different hours.

cards.title: Student Union Game Room
cards.subtitle: Inside the UConn Student Union
cards.notes: Make this a low-key meetup stop: confirm the day’s building hours, then use the game room as one option among the Union’s listed gathering spaces.
cards.short_summary: A named recreation space within UConn’s Student Union.
cards.evidence_claim: The UConn Student Union lists the Game Room among its on-site “Places To Be.”
cards.source_title: Home | Student Union and Event Services | University of Connecticut
cards.access_notes: Inside the Student Union; check current building hours before visiting.

cards.title: Fairfield Way
cards.subtitle: Pedestrian walkway through central campus
cards.notes: Use this paved pedestrian route to link a central-campus walk with stops at the Student Union, library, and nearby academic buildings; watch for scheduled events.
cards.short_summary: A paved pedestrian corridor through the campus core.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn Student Union and Event Services describes Fairfield Way as a paved pedestrian walkway through the center of campus, close to the Student Union, School of Business, and library.
cards.source_title: Event Spaces | Student Union and Event Services | University of Connecticut
cards.access_notes: This is an outdoor pedestrian route; event use is separately reservable, so allow for possible programmed activity.

cards.entity_name: The William Benton Museum of Art
cards.title: The William Benton Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: UConn Storrs campus
cards.notes: Build in a gallery stop between classes: check for closures, leave food and large bags outside the galleries, and give the current exhibition time to breathe.
cards.short_summary: UConn’s art museum, with free gallery admission and rotating exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The William Benton Museum of Art states that admission to its galleries is free; it publishes current gallery hours and visitor rules.
cards.source_title: Hours & Admission | The William Benton Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Gallery hours are Tuesday–Friday 10 a.m.–4 p.m. and Saturday–Sunday 1–4 p.m., subject to listed closures; no food, drink, or large bags in galleries.

cards.title: Jorgensen Gallery
cards.subtitle: Lower level, Jorgensen Center for the Performing Arts
cards.notes: Check the exhibition calendar, then take the lower-level gallery loop before or after a campus errand; confirm regular building hours for the day.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level contemporary-art gallery at Jorgensen with free public admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Jorgensen Gallery is on the lower level of the Jorgensen Center and is free and open to the public during regular building hours unless otherwise noted.
cards.source_title: Jorgensen Gallery | Jorgensen Center for the Performing Arts
cards.access_notes: The gallery publishes seasonal hours and may have exceptions; verify the exhibition page before making a special trip.

cards.entity_name: Jorgensen Center for the Performing Arts
cards.title: Jorgensen Center for the Performing Arts
cards.subtitle: 2132 Hillside Road
cards.notes: Look through the season schedule with friends and use the official box office for tickets; the venue also contains the gallery and Harriet S. Jorgensen Theatre.
cards.short_summary: A public UConn performing-arts venue presenting music, dance, theatre, comedy, and family programming.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn says Jorgensen presents 25–30 artists and ensembles each season across music, dance, comedy, family programming, and contemporary entertainment, and houses the gallery and Harriet S. Jorgensen Theater.
cards.source_title: About | Jorgensen Center for the Performing Arts
cards.access_notes: Ticket needs and event availability vary. UConn directs visitors to the official season schedule and box office for event information.

cards.title: UConn Dairy Bar
cards.subtitle: 17 Manter Road, Horsebarn Hill
cards.notes: Pair a Horsebarn Hill walk with a Dairy Bar stop, and check the official retail-hours page before leaving; seasonal and holiday changes can affect service.
cards.short_summary: UConn’s retail Dairy Bar, selling Creamery-made ice cream, cheese, eggs, and frozen treats.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn Dining states that the Dairy Bar opened in 1953 to sell products made by the UConn Creamery and is located at 17 Manter Road in the Horsebarn Hill area.
cards.source_title: UConn Dairy Bar | Dining Services | University of Connecticut
cards.access_notes: UConn currently lists daily 11 a.m.–9 p.m. hours, subject to seasonal and holiday changes; purchases are sold at this retail establishment.
